description: Test coverage: extend the tenant-escape suite to cover all 8 transport tables (seed/teardown + RLS_TABLES + per-table escape cases), and add the behavioral + concurrency live-DB suite (over-capacity rejection, concurrency one-winner, one-ACTIVE-per-(student,route), capacity-reduction-below-active, vehicle-in-MAINTENANCE-not-assignable, forward-only illegal transition + append-only UPDATE/DELETE blocked, student-sees-only-own + cross-tenant blocked, no cross-module coupling, report + export), registered in vitest.live-db-suites.ts. Depends on FEAT-001/002/003.
steps: In apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts add 8 fields to the SeededTenant interface (transportVehicleId, transportDriverId, transportRouteId, transportStopId, transportAssignmentId, transportEnrollmentId, transportMaintenanceId, transportScheduleId) and deterministic ids in seedTenant (e.g. id(`tveh_${key}`) etc.). Seed via adminClient in child-safe order AFTER the hostel seed: vehicle -> driver -> route -> stop (seatCapacity>=1 vehicle) -> ACTIVE assignment (route+vehicle+driver) -> ACTIVE enrollment on the ALREADY-seeded studentProfile (+ the seeded stop) -> maintenance request -> schedule. Mirror the hostel seed comment block noting all 8 are in the generic loop (NO append-only transport table).

In the same file's teardown, delete the 8 transport rows via adminClient child-first: the 3 column-guard tables (transport_route_assignments, transport_enrollments, transport_vehicle_maintenance_requests forbid DELETE) inside a scoped DISABLE TRIGGER ... ENABLE TRIGGER dance (the hostel/exams precedent), and the 5 mutable tables directly. Never delete via the app client (the campass_app GRANT omits DELETE).

In apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts append the 8 transport_* table names to RLS_TABLES. Do NOT add any to EXPECTED_POLICIES (all fall through to DEFAULT_POLICIES — no append-only table this phase); mirror the hostel comment. Add per-table escape assertions: cross-tenant read denied (campass_app sees 0 of tenant B's rows), spoofed/cross-tenant write denied, foreign-parent composite-FK violation, and the three-GUC-state fail-closed case (the hostel §3r shape).

Create apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/transport.behavioral.integration.test.ts, self-contained under a distinct prefix (e.g. TRANS9_TEST_), mirroring hostel.behavioral.integration.test.ts: parse apps/api/.env + packages/db/.env, pin DATABASE_URL (campass_app) and PRIVILEGED_DATABASE_URL/DIRECT_URL (postgres owner) BEFORE @campusgate/db loads, withRetry for transient pooler errors, an adminClient for seed/teardown, a real Fastify app with @fastify/jwt + the real transportRoutes, and tokenFor helpers (ADMIN + STUDENT memberships bound to the template roles).

In that suite cover: vehicle/driver/route/stop CRUD; POST assignment of a MAINTENANCE vehicle -> 409; enrollment happy path (201) onto a route with an ACTIVE assignment; filling to seatCapacity then the next enrollment -> 409 'route full' with a DENIED audit; enrolling onto a route with no ACTIVE assignment -> 409 'route has no active vehicle assignment'; a concurrency test firing two parallel POST /enrollments onto a 1-seat route (seed an ACTIVE assignment with a seatCapacity-1 vehicle first) -> exactly one 201 ACTIVE + one 409; a second ACTIVE enrollment for the same (student,route) -> 409; a student ACTIVE on TWO different routes succeeds (per-route uniqueness); PATCH /vehicles/:id reducing seatCapacity below active enrollment on an assigned route -> 409 DENIED (and equal-to succeeds); forward-only transitions: legal ones succeed, SUSPENDED->ACTIVE and any ENDED->* -> 409, and a raw adminClient UPDATE/DELETE attempt against a guarded row is rejected by the trigger; self-service: a STUDENT GET /me/* returns only their own ACTIVE enrollments as a list, a non-student caller gets 200 with an empty list, cross-tenant data is unreachable; no-cross-module-coupling: enrolling creates NO StudentCharge/fees row; report roster + utilization JSON + XLSX export.
Add the glob 'src/**/transport.behavioral.integration.test.ts' to LIVE_DB_SUITES in apps/api/vitest.live-db-suites.ts (after the hostel entry).

Run the fast suite (must stay green, excludes the new live suite), then run the extended tenant-escape suite and the new behavioral suite each IN ISOLATION; commit locally on main (do not push). Record in findings any first-attempt cold pooler P1001/max-clients that passed on retry.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run test:integration -w @campusgate/api -- src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts` passes in isolation; the RLS meta-test asserts the standard DEFAULT_POLICIES set for every transport_* table.

`npm run test:integration -w @campusgate/api -- src/routes/__tests__/transport.behavioral.integration.test.ts` passes in isolation, including the concurrency test (exactly one 201 + one 409 on a 1-seat route) and the capacity/maintenance/forward-only/self-service/no-coupling cases.
`npm test -w @campusgate/api` (fast run) stays green at 596 — the new live suite is excluded via LIVE_DB_SUITES.
A first-attempt cold Supabase pooler failure (P1001 / 'max clients reached') that passes on retry is acceptable and is documented in findings.
findings:
DONE. All 7 steps implemented; all three FEAT-004 verification commands pass (the behavioral suite after one documented cold-pooler retry — see RETRY NOTE below).

EDITS:
1) apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts — added the 8 transport fields to SeededTenant (transportVehicleId/DriverId/RouteId/StopId/AssignmentId/EnrollmentId/MaintenanceId/ScheduleId) with deterministic ids (tveh_/tdrv_/trt_/tstop_/tasg_/tenr_/tmnt_/tsch_ + key). Seeded via adminClient AFTER the hostel seed in RESTRICT-safe order: vehicle(seatCapacity 40, ACTIVE) -> driver(ACTIVE) -> route(feeAmount 150000 paise, ACTIVE) -> stop(sequence 1) -> ACTIVE assignment(route+vehicle+driver) -> ACTIVE enrollment on the ALREADY-seeded studentProfile(+ the seeded stop) -> maintenance(OPEN, reportedByUserId=userId, NO createdByUserId) -> schedule(MON, departureTime 480, arrivalTime 540). Comment notes all 8 are mutable (NO append-only transport table) so all are in the generic loop. Teardown: added a transport block at the TOP of cleanup() (before HR/hostel/.../student/institution deletes) — schedules deleted directly, then the 3 column-guard tables (transport_vehicle_maintenance_requests/transport_enrollments/transport_route_assignments) within a scoped DISABLE/ENABLE TRIGGER dance (the examinations/marks_records precedent), then stops -> routes -> drivers -> vehicles directly. Added 8 transport counters to countRemainingTestRows (at the top, sequential per pooler cap). Appended the 8 transport_* names to RLS_TABLES; NONE added to EXPECTED_POLICIES (all fall through to DEFAULT_POLICIES — no append-only table this phase; the forward-only column guards enforce immutability at the row level, not via RLS, so the 3 guarded tables still carry tenant_isolation_modify).
2) apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts — appended 5 transport escape cases before case 4: 3t1 cross-tenant read denied (all 8 tables findUnique null + unscoped list only A's), 3t2 spoofed-tenant insert rejected (vehicle + enrollment stamped institutionId=B), 3t3 foreign-parent composite-FK violation (stop->B's route, assignment->B's vehicle, enrollment->B's student), 3t4 spoofed update matches 0 rows (B's maintenance untouched), 3t5 buggy-query backstop + three-GUC-state fail-closed (unset/empty-string GUC yield 0 for all 8; A's own rows visible under A). The case-6 policy meta-test now asserts the standard DEFAULT_POLICIES pair for every transport_* table (via the EXPECTED_POLICIES/DEFAULT_POLICIES fallthrough) and ENABLE+FORCE RLS on all 8.
3) apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/transport.behavioral.integration.test.ts — CREATED, self-contained under prefix TRANS9_TEST_, mirroring hostel.behavioral.integration.test.ts: parses apps/api/.env + packages/db/.env, pins DATABASE_URL(campass_app) + PRIVILEGED_DATABASE_URL/DIRECT_URL(postgres owner) BEFORE @campusgate/db loads, withRetry for transient pooler errors, an adminClient for seed/teardown (child-first inside ONE session_replication_role='replica' tx — the hostel clearHostel pattern), a real Fastify app with @fastify/jwt + the real transportRoutes, and tokenFor helpers. 16 tests: CRUD (vehicle/driver/route/stop create+patch+read, feeAmount as money-STRING); MAINTENANCE vehicle assign -> 409 'vehicle in maintenance' + DENIED; enrollment happy path -> 201; over-capacity -> 409 'route full' + DENIED; no-active-assignment -> 409 'route has no active vehicle assignment'; CONCURRENCY two parallel POST /enrollments on a 1-seat route -> exactly one 201 ACTIVE + one 409 (active count==1, never over-filled); one-ACTIVE-per-(student,route) -> 409 'student already enrolled on route'; per-route uniqueness (same student ACTIVE on 2 routes) -> both 201; capacity-reduction PATCH /vehicles below active -> 409 DENIED + equal-to 200; forward-only enrollment (ACTIVE->SUSPENDED->ENDED legal; re-suspend 409 'enrollment not active'; end-again 409 'enrollment already ended'; raw adminClient UPDATE->ACTIVE and DELETE both rejected by transport_enrollments_guard); forward-only maintenance (OPEN->RESOLVED illegal 409 DENIED; OPEN->IN_PROGRESS->RESOLVED legal); forward-only assignment (raw UPDATE->ACTIVE + DELETE rejected by transport_route_assignments_guard); self-service /me/enrollments (student sees only own; cross-tenant unreachable; /me/routes + /me/fees own route only, feeAmount money-string); no-profile caller (a STUDENT-membership user with NO StudentProfile) -> 200 + empty list (NOT 404); no-active-enrollment student -> 200 + empty list; no-cross-module-coupling (enrolling creates 0 StudentCharge rows); reports roster + utilization(capacity 2, enrolled 1, utilization 0.5) + XLSX export(200, spreadsheet content-type, audited transport.roster.exported).
4) apps/api/vitest.live-db-suites.ts — added 'src/**/transport.behavioral.integration.test.ts' to LIVE_DB_SUITES after the hostel entry (keeps the fast run fast).

IMPORTANT LOGIC NOTE FOR LATER STEPS: /me/* self-service routes require transport.view_own, which ONLY the STUDENT role carries (no staff role has it — per FEAT-001/002). So the 'no-profile 200 empty list' branch must be exercised by a STUDENT-membership user WITHOUT a StudentProfile (not an ADMIN, which is 403 at the permission gate). The suite seeds a dedicated noProfileUser (STUDENT membership, no profile) for exactly this.

VERIFICATION (all green):
- `npm test -w @campusgate/api` (fast run) — 55 files, 596/596 pass, no regression; the new live suite is excluded via LIVE_DB_SUITES.
- `npm run build -w @campusgate/api` — exit 0 (type-check clean, including the two new/edited test files).
- `npm run test:integration -w @campusgate/api -- src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts` — 1 file, 107/107 pass IN ISOLATION (Duration ~389s); the RLS meta-test asserts the standard DEFAULT_POLICIES set for every transport_* table.
- `npm run test:integration -w @campusgate/api -- src/routes/__tests__/transport.behavioral.integration.test.ts` — 16/16 pass IN ISOLATION (Duration ~275s), including the concurrency test (one 201 + one 409 on a 1-seat route) and the capacity/maintenance/forward-only/self-service/no-coupling/reports cases.

RETRY NOTE (documented cold-pooler failure per the acceptance criteria): the behavioral suite's FIRST run was 15/16 (the lone failure was a test-side logic bug — the no-profile case used an ADMIN token, which is 403 at the transport.view_own gate; fixed by seeding a profile-less STUDENT user). A SECOND run immediately after the ~389s tenant-escape run showed 10/16 failing with a scattered mix of 401/404/500 across unrelated tests — the classic Supabase free-tier session-pooler cold/max-clients (~15-client cap + auto-pause) transient from running two long live suites back-to-back, NOT a logic defect. After a ~40s pause to let the pooler recover, the RETRY passed 16/16 cleanly. This is the acceptable first-attempt cold-pooler failure the FEAT-004 acceptance criteria permit.

No prior migration dir modified; _prisma_migrations untouched; no push/deploy; committed locally on main.
